notes: The architecture puts two distributions side by side and measures the divergence. We had one distribution and one scalar — a full probability distribution of our own modelled value, compared against a single market price. "Measure divergence of distributions" was therefore "measure distance from a point", which cannot produce three of the five things the design says it measures: probability of outperformance, tail risk, and confidence all require a distribution on *both* sides.
